rows.grounds: ordinal specifying the next contemplative object in sequence
temporal adverb indicating sequence after the prior step
first member of compound describing the object of contemplation
second member of compound, denoting the terminal part

items.question: What fourth contemplative object must be focused upon after the preceding accomplishment?
premises: The instruction is addressed to the goddess and follows a prior stage.
A fourth item is explicitly designated for contemplation.
The specified object is the end of a word (pada-anta).
items.inference: Therefore, after that stage, the practitioner should contemplate the fourth object, namely the word-end.
uncertainties: The precise referent of pada-anta (end of a word, final syllable, or terminal part of a mantra-unit) depends on the ritual context.
items.plain_english: And then, O Goddess, one should contemplate the fourth, the end of the word.
